			exists = root
			is_adult = yes
			eotg_portrait_prosthetic_leg_trigger = yes

			accessory = { mode = add gene = eotg_cyber_leg template = eotg_actuator_leg_l_backstreet value = 0.5 }
		} }
	}

	eotg_leg_std_clinic = {
		trigger = {
			exists = root
			is_adult = yes
			eotg_portrait_prosthetic_leg_trigger = yes
		}
		dna_modifiers = { human = {
			morph = { mode = add gene = gene_one_legged template = no_left_leg value = 1.0 }
			accessory = { mode = add gene = eotg_cyber_leg template = eotg_actuator_leg_l_clinic value = 0.5 }
		} }
	}
}
